newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Bombay Dyeing down after results.
newsitem.headline: India's Bombay Dyeing down after results.

text.p: Shares of textiles and chemicals maker Bombay Dyeing fell 6.25 rupees, or 6.3 percent, to 93.50 in early trade on the Bombay bourse on Tuesday after the firm announced a fall in its 1996/97 net, traders said.
The company said late on Monday its net profit fell sharply to 357 million in the year ended March 31, from 1.17 billion rupees in 1995/96.
Sales dropped to 9.89 billion rupees, from 13.89 billion in the previous year.

The firm said turnover and profitibility had been affected by a severe downward pressure on international prices of polyester inputs. Margins continue to be under pressure though prices have since recovered from their record lows.
